title: Minimum-weight frames under subresonant harmonic excitation: Robust constraints on dynamic compliance, peak input power, and eigenfrequencies
summary: This work addresses minimum-weight design of undamped Euler-Bernoulli frame structures under subresonant single-frequency harmonic excitations, focusing on (robust) dynamic compliance and (robust) peak input power with ellipsoidal load uncertainty. We develop a semidefinite reformulation of robust dynamic compliance for subresonant single-frequency excitation and prove its equivalence to robust peak input power.
